title: Measure the level of a tone
brief: Build the RMS, the peak and RMS levels in dBFS, and a sampled cosine, then measure the running 440 Hz example.
hints: The RMS is np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2)): square, average, then take the root.
A level in dBFS is 20 * np.log10(max(value, eps)); use 20 because the value is an amplitude, not a power.
Sample n is taken at time n / sample_rate, so build n = np.arange(N) and compute 2 * np.pi * frequency * n / sample_rate.
A half-scale sine has a peak of 0.5, which is -6.02 dBFS, and an RMS of 0.5 / sqrt(2), which is -9.03 dBFS.
